model.title: Wabeno Economic Development Act
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee, Natural Resources Committee, Agriculture Committee · Rep. Thomas Tiffany (R-WI)

summary.text: The bill would require the Forest Service to sell approximately 14 acres of federal land in Wisconsin's Chequamegon-Nicolet National Forest to a private company at fair market value, provided the company makes an offer within 180 days of an appraisal. It would also direct the Department of the Interior to review federal permitting processes for stone, sand, and gravel development on public lands.
